“我向魔神起誓要是我拿了里面的东西，让我的天打五雷轰。”千身逼得没有办法了。

撇撇嘴，苏天宇刚想要反驳，但是看到李天瞪起来的眼睛之后，苏天宇很不甘心的把话重新咽回到肚子里。

“散弹击！”黑蛙的身体虽然被凌乾的攻击所伤，但却是没有受到多大的伤害。望着无边无际雷龙，黑蛙彻底愤怒了，不知吐出了多少黑色的具有剧毒的气泡，毫不留情的与凌乾的雷龙撞击在了一起。

紧接着,雨菲霖伸出一对玉臂,环住了周天龙的腰,随即将自己的身体紧紧地靠在周天龙的身上,头也靠在周天龙的肩膀上。

“还有，宗主让我告诉你，让你去天雨峰的后山，寻找上任宗主雨落天，让他协助你，重新建立天雨宗！”雨鹏又对周天龙说道。

李峰对着谢媛依笑了笑，示意她放心，而谢媛依对李峰很放心，她相信他。

周天龙发现，无论是南奇，还是那个黑大个，都是火属性的武者。这种帝武境高手之间的战斗，真可谓是毁天灭地，无尽的火焰在天空之上盘旋，整个天空都成为了一片火海，被染成了赤红之色。

“你是不是跟肥四混的？”兰馨的爸爸据说以前是混过，后来跟她妈妈好了之后，便退隐江湖了，也算是老一辈的人了，知道肥四的名字也不稀奇。

刀刀相击，斩天裂地的气势没有丝毫的减弱，一刀一击，无情的疯狂的切割着敌人的有生力量。

这两殿的人不会轻易的联手，一旦联手就表示，有什么事情，超出了他们的控制。

“时间过去太久，即便是本国，毒药解药只怕也早已失传，希望渺芒，你不必费心。”无烟出言拒绝。

无数莹光飒然浮空，有如鲛人珠泪，星星点点地闪烁，由水袖中飞出。

“这一刀，是因为你们活活将我爹挂在村口冻死！”另一个年轻人则更加激动地对着另一个强盗重重地砍了下去。

"I swear to the devil that if I take the things inside, my heaven will strike with five thunders." Qianshen was forced to have no choice.

Pouring his lips, Su Tianyu was about to refute, but after seeing Li Tian's eyes widening, Su Tianyu reluctantly swallowed the words back in his stomach.

"Shot shot!" Although Black Frog's body was injured by Ling Gan's attack, he did not suffer much damage.Looking at the endless thunder dragons, Black Frog was completely angry. He spat out countless black poisonous bubbles and collided with Ling Qian's thunder dragons mercilessly.

Immediately afterwards, Yu Feilin stretched out a pair of jade arms and hugged Zhou Tianlong's waist, then pressed her body tightly against Zhou Tianlong's body and rested her head on Zhou Tianlong's shoulder.

"Also, the sect master asked me to tell you to go to the back mountain of Tianyu Peak to find the previous sect master Yu Luotian and ask him to assist you in re-establishing the Tianyu Sect!" Yu Peng said to Zhou Tianlong again.

Li Feng smiled at Xie Yuanyi and reassured her, but Xie Yuanyi was very relieved about Li Feng and she believed in him.

Zhou Tianlong discovered that both Nan Qi and the big black man were fire attribute warriors.This kind of battle between masters of the Imperial Martial Realm was truly devastating. Endless flames hovered in the sky, and the entire sky became a sea of ​​fire, dyed crimson.

"Did you hang out with Fat Si?" It is said that Lan Xin's father used to hang out with her mother, and then retired from the world after getting married with her mother. He is considered an older generation, and it is not unusual to know Fat Si's name.

The swords and knives struck each other, and the momentum of slashing the sky and splitting the earth did not weaken at all. One blow after another, the enemy's vitality was cut ruthlessly and crazily.

People from these two palaces will not easily join forces. Once they join forces, it means that something is beyond their control.

"It's been too long. Even in our own country, the poison and antidote have probably been lost. I hope you don't have to worry about it." Wu Yan refused.

Countless shining lights floated in the air, like mermaid tears, twinkling like stars, flying out of the water sleeves.

"This knife is because you hung my father alive at the entrance of the village and froze to death!" Another young man became even more excited and slashed hard at the other robber.
